pages.text: $(bold)JEI$(): the item list on the right of your inventory. Hover an item, press $(bold)R$() for how to make it, $(bold)U$() for what it is used in. Type $(bold)@twilightforest$() to list everything from one mod.$(br2)$(bold)Jade$(): look at any block or mob for its name, mod and health.

$(bold)Just Enough Resources$(): ore heights and mob drops, inside JEI. Look an ore up before you dig.$(br2)$(bold)Just Enough Breeding / Professions$(): what each animal eats, what each villager job block is.$(br2)$(bold)Enchantment Descriptions$(): hover a book and it says what the enchantment does.

$(bold)FTB Quests$(): the book icon at the top left of your inventory. Chapters for every dimension, with rewards.$(br2)$(bold)AppleSkin$(): hover food to see how much hunger and saturation it gives.$(br2)Several mods ship their own guide book. If you find one, read it.
